summary: Structure green, social, and sustainability-linked loans and bonds with practical ICMA, LMA, KPI, and impact reporting exercises. Enquire today.
lede: The Structuring Green, Social and Sustainability-Linked Loans and Bonds training shows how to turn transaction objectives into financeable documentation using ICMA and LMA principles. Practise selecting eligible projects, calibrating sustainability performance targets, setting baselines, measuring impact, and defining allocation and performance reporting obligations. Build a sustainable finance framework, term sheet, KPI reference sheet, and reporting pack around a recurring transaction. The course also develops Excel-based allocation and KPI dashboards and prepares you to negotiate missed-target and verification terms, then present a credible monitoring approach to credit committees, boards, and investors.
audienceIntro: This sustainable finance course is designed for professionals who originate, advise on, approve, monitor, or communicate green, social, and sustainability-linked financing transactions. It suits intermediate practitioners who can relate financing structures to corporate strategy, credit processes, treasury priorities, and measurable sustainability outcomes.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to corporate finance, commercial lending, treasury, debt capital markets, development finance, ESG, or sustainability reporting. No programming is required. Familiarity with financial statements, loan or bond terminology, and basic sustainability metrics will help, but the course introduces the ICMA and LMA structures used in the exercises. Advanced topics such as IFRS S1, IFRS S2, IRIS+, AI-assisted review, and dashboard automation receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than production-system implementation. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if you want to complete the optional Excel exercises. TrainingCred can provide case data, templates, and reference materials.
